name: test_genomic_range_table_grch38
body:
def test_genomic_range_table_grch38():
    actual = hl.utils.genomic_range_table(10, reference_genome='GRCh38').collect()
    expected = [hl.Struct(locus=hl.Locus('chr1', pos + 1, reference_genome='GRCh38')) for pos in range(10)]
    assert actual == expected
